reasoning: Shows a solid Wi-Fi signal wedge with a question-mark badge, clearly signaling an unknown wireless network, Wi-Fi password query, or wireless troubleshooting task. It fits a narrow but common family of home and travel tech tasks, though the solid wedge shape is slightly less recognizable at small sizes than arched Wi-Fi bars.
